Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: Misread the search results/knowledge panel and stated that Ruth Hanna McCormick’s father was Medill McCormick (who was actually her husband). This confusion between spouse and parent contradicted authoritative sources on the same results page identifying her father as Senator Marcus Alonzo Hanna, leading toward an incorrect father-in-law for Albert G. Simms.
